# Net Forge monster collector template (MOSSBOUND)

> A shared marsh for up to 8 keepers. Each picks one of the starters at
> camp, walks the marsh, meets wild creatures in tall grass and battles them
> turn by turn with a team of three, snaring the ones worth keeping. Every
> keeper in the marsh wears down the same warden; it must fall before dusk.
> You change the game by editing src/game.ts only. The template already has
> walking and collision, encounters, turn order, damage, the element cycle,
> snaring, team swaps, XP and levels, the camp, the warden fight, dusk,
> netcode, rendering, touch controls, earn and the store. Do not write
> renderers, netcode or battle AI.

## Files

- src/game.ts: THE GAME. Declarations against @netforge/engine:
  game(), marsh(), creature(), move(), upgrade(), earn.rule(), earn.stake(), store.sku().
- src/names.json: the title and every label players read. Creatures go in
  "weapons" ({ name, line }), the warden in "enemies", plus upgrades, earn
  rules and store items. Moves are shown from their ids ("leaf_lash" reads
  "Leaf Lash"), so name moves the way players should read them.
- Everything else is template machinery.

## Rules the build enforces

- game({ template: "collector", style, places, players: { prefab, max } }).
- Exactly one marsh(...); 1 to 24 creature(...)s; at most 48 move(...)s.
- Every creature's moves are declared moves (1 to 4 each).
- marsh starters and grass pools name declared creatures that are not
  bosses; the warden names a creature with boss: true.
- The camp and the warden stand inside the marsh on tiles that are not
  blocked; grass and blocked rects stay inside the marsh.
- Elements are "root", "tide", "spark", "stone": a cycle where each beats
  the next (root soaks tide, tide shorts spark, spark cracks stone, stone
  crushes root). Strong hits deal 1.5x, weak ones 0.67x.
- Upgrades read five stats only: might (team attack), maxHealth (team
  health, a fraction: 0.15 is +15%), armor (team defence), amount (extra
  snares) and regen (share of max health healed each second out of battle).
- No weapon(...): a collector game declares creature(...) and move(...).
- Asset ids look like "style.lowpoly.frog", never URLs or paths, and must be
  in the asset library. game({ style }) is the art style the creator picked
  (lowpoly, toon, ps1, pixel, voxel or handdrawn); keep it.
- 4 playtest keepers must win battles, catch creatures and fire an earn rule
  in 4 minutes, and must not lose their whole team more than twice each.

## Units

A tile is 2 m; marsh rects are [x, y, width, height] in tiles. Stats are
base values at level 1 and grow 12% a level. power 40 is a plain hit.
Walking speed is metres a second. Tick rate 30 Hz.

## The loop

A keeper picks a starter at camp (starterLevel). Every step into a new tile
of tall grass rolls the zone's rate; a hit starts a battle with a creature
from the zone's pool at a level in its range. A turn: you pick a move, a
swap, a snare or flee; the faster creature acts first; the foe answers
with its best move. A beaten foe gives XP (the active creature full, the
rest half). A snare's chance is catchRate x (0.25 + 0.75 x the foe's
missing health); a caught creature joins the team (three at most; more go
into the lantern). Wild creatures hit at 80%. If your whole team faints you
are sent to camp with half health; standing at camp heals. Near the
warden, Challenge starts the warden fight: its health is one pool for the
whole marsh, it hits at full strength, and when it falls everyone who hurt
it shares the win. At dusk the run is lost.

## Common changes

### A new creature
creature("thistlehog", { model: "style.lowpoly.fox", element: "root", hp: 50, atk: 52, def: 48, spd: 46, moves: ["leaf_lash", "thorn_curl"], catchRate: 0.7 });
move("thorn_curl", { element: "root", power: 0, effect: "guard" });
Then put it in a grass pool, and its label in names.json weapons.

### Moves
move("tide_crash", { element: "tide", power: 70, accuracy: 0.8 });
effect "drain" heals half the damage dealt; "heal" (power 0) restores
amount of max health; "guard" halves the next hit taken.

### The map
marsh({ size: [30, 20], camp: [2, 10], water: [[11, 0, 2, 6]], blocked: [[19, 0, 1, 8]],
  grass: [{ at: [4, 2, 6, 5], rate: 0.22, pool: [{ creature: "sporecap", weight: 3, level: [2, 3] }] }], ... });
Put weak creatures near camp and stronger ones toward the warden. Leave a
walkable way from camp to every grass zone and to the warden.

### Harder or easier
Raise pool levels, the warden's level or hp, or lower snares and grass
rates. "Longer": a later dusk. "More catching": higher catchRate and snares.

### Add an earn rule
earn.rule("ten_wins", { when: "creature.defeated", n: 10, pay: 15, oncePer: "run" });
Events: creature.caught, creature.defeated, creature.levelup, level.five
and level.ten (each credits the keeper), warden.defeated (everyone who hurt
it), run.won (everyone in the marsh). Each rule pays once per run per player,
in coins; the room server is the referee.

### The buy-in run (required)
earn.stake({ min: 20, max: 200, multiple: 2 });
One top-level line; a game without it does not build. "stake" is reserved.

### Coins: earn and the store
Every game has coins: 1 coin = 1 of the game's own token, shown under the
token's own name, symbol and logo.
store.sku("thornbark", { coins: 40 });                                  // one level of the "thornbark" upgrade for the run
store.sku("skin_amber", { coins: 500, grants: { cosmetic: 2 } });       // a keeper's cloak, owned for good
store.sku("lucky_reed", { coins: 150, grants: { gear: "thornbark", loseBelow: 0.25 } }); // losable gear
Keep the SKUs the client is wired to (thornbark, mossmail, spare_snares,
fen_tonic, skin_lichen, skin_amber, lucky_reed) at their prices.

## Test

engine.test.run({ ticks: 30 * 240, bots: 4 }) plays the marsh with 4
keepers and reports battles won plus catches (kills), 1 + catches (wave),
the highest level, team wipes (deaths), earned by rule, softlock, ms per
tick, and the genre's own checks under rules.checks.

## Worked example: src/game.ts

This is the template's complete src/game.ts as it ships. A new game on this
template starts from this file and changes declarations in place.

```ts
/**
 * MOSSBOUND: the monster collector template (play style: monster-collector RPG).
 *
 * Fen spirits live in the tall grass of a flooded marsh. Each keeper picks
 * one of three starters at camp, walks the reeds, meets wild spirits in the
 * grass and battles them turn by turn with a team of three, snaring the
 * ones worth keeping in a reed lantern. At the far end of the marsh the
 * Fenwarden waits: every keeper in the marsh wears down the same warden,
 * and it must fall before dusk.
 *
 * This file is the whole game as the model writes it: declarations only,
 * against the typed API in @netforge/engine. Walking, encounters,
 * battles, catching, levels, netcode, renderer and referee are the
 * template's machinery.
 */
import { creature, earn, game, marsh, move, store, upgrade } from "@netforge/engine";

export default game({
  template: "collector",
  style: "lowpoly",
  places: { fen: { chunks: "places/fen", spawn: [0, 0, 0] } },
  players: { prefab: "style.lowpoly.hooded_adventurer", max: 8 },
});

// The marsh: 30 x 20 tiles of 2 m. Camp in the west, the warden's mound in the east, water and rocks between.
marsh({
  size: [30, 20],
  camp: [2, 10],
  starters: ["mossling", "cindertail", "puddlewump"],
  starterLevel: 4,
  water: [
    [11, 0, 2, 6],
    [11, 14, 2, 6],
    [24, 0, 3, 3],
  ],
  blocked: [
    [19, 0, 1, 8],
    [19, 12, 1, 8],
    [8, 9, 1, 2],
    [15, 2, 1, 1],
    [16, 16, 1, 1],
  ],
  grass: [
    { at: [4, 2, 6, 5], rate: 0.22, pool: [{ creature: "sporecap", weight: 3, level: [2, 3] }, { creature: "voltmoth", weight: 2, level: [2, 3] }, { creature: "reedcrab", weight: 1, level: [2, 4] }] },
    { at: [4, 13, 6, 5], rate: 0.22, pool: [{ creature: "reedcrab", weight: 2, level: [2, 4] }, { creature: "sporecap", weight: 1, level: [3, 4] }, { creature: "pebblewing", weight: 1, level: [3, 4] }] },
    { at: [14, 7, 4, 6], rate: 0.2, pool: [{ creature: "pebblewing", weight: 2, level: [4, 6] }, { creature: "voltmoth", weight: 2, level: [4, 6] }, { creature: "bogling", weight: 1, level: [5, 6] }] },
    { at: [21, 4, 4, 12], rate: 0.18, pool: [{ creature: "bogling", weight: 2, level: [6, 8] }, { creature: "pebblewing", weight: 1, level: [6, 8] }, { creature: "reedcrab", weight: 1, level: [6, 8] }] },
  ],
  warden: { creature: "fenwarden", at: [27, 10], level: 9, hp: 700 },
  dusk: 600,
  snares: 6,
});

// Creatures. Base stats at level 1 (each grows 12% a level); catchRate scales every snare.
creature("mossling", { model: "style.lowpoly.frog", element: "root", hp: 46, atk: 48, def: 50, spd: 44, moves: ["leaf_lash", "sap_drink"] });
creature("cindertail", { model: "style.lowpoly.fox", element: "spark", hp: 40, atk: 54, def: 42, spd: 58, moves: ["ember_nip", "static_dash"] });
creature("puddlewump", { model: "style.lowpoly.slime_drop", element: "tide", hp: 52, atk: 44, def: 52, spd: 40, moves: ["splash_jab", "bubble_ward"] });
creature("sporecap", { model: "style.lowpoly.mushroom_imp", element: "root", hp: 42, atk: 46, def: 46, spd: 38, moves: ["spore_puff", "leaf_lash"], catchRate: 0.9 });
creature("voltmoth", { model: "style.lowpoly.bee", element: "spark", hp: 36, atk: 50, def: 38, spd: 64, moves: ["static_dash", "ember_nip"], catchRate: 0.85 });
creature("reedcrab", { model: "style.lowpoly.crab", element: "tide", hp: 48, atk: 50, def: 60, spd: 36, moves: ["splash_jab", "shell_up"], catchRate: 0.8 });
creature("pebblewing", { model: "style.lowpoly.pebble_flyer", element: "stone", hp: 44, atk: 48, def: 56, spd: 50, moves: ["gravel_toss", "shell_up"], catchRate: 0.7 });
creature("bogling", { model: "style.lowpoly.blob_orc", element: "stone", hp: 60, atk: 52, def: 54, spd: 30, moves: ["gravel_toss", "mire_slam"], catchRate: 0.6, size: 1.3 });
creature("fenwarden", { model: "style.lowpoly.mushroom_king", element: "stone", hp: 120, atk: 66, def: 64, spd: 40, moves: ["mire_slam", "gravel_toss", "sap_drink"], boss: true, size: 3.4 });

// Moves. power 40 is a plain hit; drain heals half the damage, heal restores a share of max health, guard halves the next hit.
move("leaf_lash", { element: "root", power: 40 });
move("sap_drink", { element: "root", power: 30, effect: "drain" });
move("spore_puff", { element: "root", power: 45, accuracy: 0.9 });
move("ember_nip", { element: "spark", power: 40 });
move("static_dash", { element: "spark", power: 55, accuracy: 0.85 });
move("splash_jab", { element: "tide", power: 40 });
move("bubble_ward", { element: "tide", power: 0, effect: "heal", amount: 0.3 });
move("gravel_toss", { element: "stone", power: 40 });
move("shell_up", { element: "stone", power: 0, effect: "guard" });
move("mire_slam", { element: "stone", power: 70, accuracy: 0.8 });

// Store upgrades: one level each, for the rest of the run, on the buyer's own team.
upgrade("thornbark", { stat: "might", step: 0.15, maxLevel: 1 });
upgrade("mossmail", { stat: "armor", step: 0.15, maxLevel: 1 });
upgrade("spare_snares", { stat: "amount", step: 3, maxLevel: 1 });
upgrade("fen_tonic", { stat: "regen", step: 0.03, maxLevel: 1 });

// Earn (mandatory). Pays the game's coins (1 coin = 1 token), once per run each. Values are PLACEHOLDER.
earn.rule("first_snare", { when: "creature.caught", n: 1, pay: 5, oncePer: "run" });
earn.rule("full_lantern", { when: "creature.caught", n: 3, pay: 20, oncePer: "run" });
earn.rule("warden_breaker", { when: "warden.defeated", n: 1, pay: 50, oncePer: "run" });
earn.rule("seasoned", { when: "level.five", n: 1, pay: 5, oncePer: "run" });
// Buy-in run (the mandatory sink loop): stake coins at run start to earn above free play.
// A staked run also pays up to stake x multiple, by the share of this run's earn the player makes. Values are PLACEHOLDER.
earn.stake({ min: 20, max: 200, multiple: 2 });

// Store (the Kit), priced in coins: four run upgrades and two keeper finishes owned for good (kept in the profile).
store.sku("thornbark", { coins: 40 });
store.sku("mossmail", { coins: 40 });
store.sku("spare_snares", { coins: 60 });
store.sku("fen_tonic", { coins: 50 });
store.sku("skin_lichen", { coins: 300, grants: { cosmetic: 1 } });
store.sku("skin_amber", { coins: 500, grants: { cosmetic: 2 } });
// Losable gear: owned for good until lost. It brings one level of its upgrade into every staked run,
// and is lost when that run makes less than loseBelow of its most earn. Values are PLACEHOLDER.
store.sku("lucky_reed", { coins: 150, grants: { gear: "thornbark", loseBelow: 0.25 } });
```

## Validate and playtest

### With the MCP server

Run `npx -y @netforge/mcp` (package @netforge/mcp, bin netforge-mcp) and
connect it to your coding agent. Its tools are netforge_list_templates, netforge_create_game,
netforge_explain_api, netforge_search_docs, netforge_validate_game, netforge_run_playtest and netforge_play_locally.

- netforge_validate_game checks src/game.ts against the engine's schemas and this
  template's rules, and returns one actionable line per problem.
- netforge_run_playtest plays the game headless with bots and returns the report.
- netforge_play_locally gives the steps to open the game in a browser with kit play.

### In code

Import the game module first so its declarations register, then run the
headless harness. This plays 4 keepers for 4 minutes at 30 Hz.

```ts
import { engine } from "@netforge/engine";
import "./src/game.js";

const report = await engine.test.run({
  ticks: 30 * 240,
  bots: 4,
  seed: 1,
  assert: [
    { name: "earn fired", check: (r) => r.earnEmitted > 0 },
    { name: "no softlock", check: (r) => !r.softlock },
  ],
});
if (report.failed.length > 0) throw new Error(report.failed.join("\n"));
```

The report has battles won plus catches (kills), team wipes (deaths), earned by rule, softlock, ms per tick and the genre's checks under rules.checks.

The template's own tests (vitest) are the reference checks:

- test/harness.test.ts
- test/store.test.ts

### Play it locally

In a folder with netnet.json and src/game.ts:

```sh
npm install @netforge/kit-play @netforge/engine @netforge/template-collector
echo '{"template":"collector"}' > netnet.json
npx kit-play        # opens http://127.0.0.1:4663
```

kit play builds the template client with your src/game.ts and runs a local
room host with play money. No wallet, no chain and no hosted servers are
involved. Open the link in more tabs for more players.
